LESSON: AREA

Grade: PP2
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: MEASUREMENT
Topic 3.7: Area

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Area. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify surfaces of different objects in the environment
2. cover surfaces of different objects by using not more 74 than 20 smaller similar objects
3. use appropriate vocabulary related to surfaces of objects for effective communication e) appreciate different surfaces of objects in the environment.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify surfaces of different objects in the environment
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify surfaces of different objects in the environment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. cover surfaces of different objects by using not more 74 than 20 smaller similar objects
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to cover surfaces of different objects by using not more 74 than 20 smaller similar objects. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. use appropriate vocabulary related to surfaces of objects for effective communication e) appreciate different surfaces of objects in the environment.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to use appropriate vocabulary related to surfaces of objects for effective communication e) appreciate different surfaces of objects in the environment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At the market in your county, count 10 mangoes. Put them in 2 groups of 5. That is sorting and grouping.

Example 2: In class, count the desks in your row. Write the number in figures and in words.

Example 3: If you have 7 shillings and your parent gives you 5 more, you have 12 shillings. That is addition.
